title: ARA_METRIC stdout marker
description: The JSON payload that follows `ARA_METRIC=` on a stdout line. Consumed by ai_scientist/utils/ara_metric_parser.py during re-execution verification.

value.description: The metric value emitted this run.

maximize.description: True when higher is better. Consumers use it to interpret drift direction.

source.description: Optional producer tag (e.g. 'text_tail' when the parser fell back to the legacy 'metric: x' format).
